verdict.rationale: The RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell is a workstation GPU, a hardware component with no product UI of its own, so API-versus-UI feature parity is a category error for this kind of product. The CUDA and SDK programming APIs in the evidence are developer libraries, not a programmatic mirror of a user interface. They do not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
